origin: AI-assisted analytical prediction draft; chronology is not verified and this is not an unaided student prediction

a.metric: Expected absolute dollar error, with nearly delta-neutral short-gamma books also having the largest relative error
a.reasoning: A delta-only model omits local curvature and time decay. Order the initial concern by absolute gamma. Local negative gamma suggests understated tail loss; a locally positive-gamma risk reversal can instead make the linear estimate conservative locally, but crossing its strikes can reverse that prediction in a far tail.

local_direction.RiskReversal: overstate locally from positive gamma; strike crossings may reverse it

b.reasoning: Theta suggests the flat-price sign; short convexity concentrates losses in unusually large moves, so the near-delta-neutral short-gamma books should have a non-Normal tail ratio.

predictions.theta_units: Dollar change per model year; divide by255 for one trading day
